title.en: Dedicated feline care with safety concerns

text.en: Several cat owners report gentle handling that helps skittish long-haired breeds relax during plush trims and baths. In sharp contrast, multiple severe complaints from eight months ago recount an animal being dropped and escaping through a window, prompting sharp warnings about safety oversight.

Clients seeking breed styling praise staff member John for patiently explaining haircut options and checking results before checkout. However, critical reviews describe unhelpful attitudes and denied responsibility following past pet handling incidents at the facility.

title.en: Plush cat cuts with occasional issues

text.en: Satisfied owners praise clean teddy bear cuts and neat lion trims on Persian cats, noting soft fur and tidy nail clips. On the other hand, a critical review described an uneven trim, emphasizing the importance of confirming grooming expectations beforehand.

q.en: Do they provide specialized cuts for long-haired cats?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention plush cuts, teddy bear styles, and lion trims specifically tailored for Persian and long-haired breeds.

q.en: What safety precautions do reviewers advise checking?

a.en: Past reviewers suggest confirming secure handling procedures and window containment before leaving cats for grooming or boarding.

q.en: What basic hygiene services are included with grooming?

a.en: Owners report that packages typically include nail trimming, bathing, eye cleaning, and coat styling.
